summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary AstraZeneca Finance LLC priced a €2.55 billion Eurobond offering across four tranches with coupons from 3.402% to 4.169% and maturities from 2030 to 2038. The notes are fully guaranteed by the parent and will be listed on the London Stock Exchange under the EMTN programme. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
